summary_en: This study tests time-restricted eating, a meal-timing plan, in adults with a solid tumor that was removed by surgery and who are starting adjuvant treatment. Participants in the time-restricted eating group eat within an 8-hour daily window that starts 1 to 3 hours after waking, on 6 or more days a week; the control group has no time limit and eats within a window of 12 or more hours per day, and the study duration is not stated. The record does not state a main outcome; the phase is listed as NA (not applicable).
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la alimentación con restricción horaria, un plan de horarios de comidas, en adultos con un tumor sólido que fue extirpado mediante cirugía y que van a iniciar tratamiento adyuvante. Los participantes del grupo de alimentación con restricción horaria comen dentro de una ventana diaria de 8 horas que empieza entre 1 y 3 horas después de despertar, 6 o más días por semana; el grupo control no tiene límite de tiempo y come dentro de una ventana de 12 horas o más al día, y la duración del estudio no se indica. El registro no indica un resultado principal; la fase aparece como NA (no aplicable).
who_for: Solid tumor treated with curative-intent surgical resection and planned adjuvant therapy
Willing and able to follow assessments, visit schedules, and restrictions
not_for: No planned systemic adjuvant therapy after surgery
Strictly keeping an eating window under 10 hours on most days
Regular overnight shift work (at least 1 night per week)
Dependent on parenteral or enteral nutrition
